{if:SF.IsMythic}{c_mythic}{/if}Your maximum number of {c_important}Skeleton Warriors{/c} and {c_important}Skeleton Mages{/c} is increased by {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 1"]{/c} and your {c_important}Summon{/c} damage is increased by {if:SF.IsMythic}{c_number}{else}{c_random}{/if}[Affix_Value_2*100|1%x|]{/c}. 

Commanding {c_important}Skeleton Warriors{/c} also causes {c_important}Skeleton Mages{/c} to focus the same target for {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 0"]{/c} seconds.{if:SF.IsMythic}{/c_mythic}{/if}
